treatments.title: Types of Braces We Offer
items: Metal Braces – durable, reliable stainless steel brackets and archwires that gradually move teeth into their correct positions, suitable for a wide range of orthodontic cases
Ceramic Braces – tooth-colored brackets that work like metal braces but blend in with your natural smile for a more discreet appearance
Self-Ligating Braces – braces with a built-in sliding mechanism that helps move teeth efficiently, often requiring fewer adjustment visits
Clear Aligner Consultation (where appropriate) – for suitable candidates, we offer a consultation to explore clear aligners as a nearly invisible, removable alternative to traditional braces

items.question: How long does braces treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration varies depending on the complexity of the case. During your consultation, your orthodontist will provide a personalized estimate.

items.question: Are braces painful?
items.answer: Patients may experience mild discomfort after placement or adjustments, but this usually subsides within a few days.

items.question: Can adults get braces?
items.answer: Yes. Braces are effective for both teenagers and adults seeking improved dental alignment and smile aesthetics.

items.question: How often are adjustment appointments needed?
items.answer: Most patients visit every 4–8 weeks so the orthodontist can monitor progress and make necessary adjustments.

items.question: What foods should I avoid while wearing braces?
items.answer: Sticky, hard, and chewy foods should generally be avoided to prevent damage to the braces.
